_comment: PRD-261 A-11b: recorded chat turns, in the stream format lib/chat/hooks.ts reads: each frame is a '0:' text line ({ text }) or a 'd:' data line ({ data }). The payloads have the shapes the backend sends (a chat-id frame naming the new chat, tool-data with a tool_approval, result_formatter.py; finish). A turn with hold: true keeps the stream open after its frames, until the browser aborts it (Stop). specs/sdk-chat.spec.ts answers the app's own POST /api/chat with them. Test data only.
